source_title: Apple launches its first touchscreen MacBook Pro: What is new, India price and more - India Today
source_excerpt:
Apple unveiled its first touchscreen MacBook Pro with OLED displays and M5 processors. The launch reverses its long-standing resistance to direct touch controls on laptops.
Apple has finally brought touchscreen support to the MacBook Pro, ending its long-standing resistance to adding touch controls to its laptops. Announced at the company's “Pro and tell” event on Wednesday, the new MacBook Pro features an OLED display, support for touch gestures and Apple's M5 Pro and M5 Max processors. The laptop also gets a redesigned interface and a lighter build.
In India, the new MacBook Pro is priced at Rs 3,49,900 for the 14-inch model and Rs 4,09,900 for the 16-inch variant. The laptop is scheduled to be available from November 9. Apple MacBook Pro: What's new A look at Apple's first-ever touchscreen laptop.
The touchscreen is the biggest change to Apple's professional laptop. Users can scroll through documents, zoom into images, draw on the display and annotate content directly on the screen. Apple says the feature will also benefit professional workflows, allowing designers to interact with 3D models and music producers to adjust controls using their fingers.
Apple has redesigned the interface to make touch interactions more natural while retaining the traditional keyboard and trackpad experience. The new MacBook Pro also introduces Dynamic Island, bringing a familiar iPhone feature to the Mac. It provides access to Spotlight search, Live Activities, music controls and other information from the top of the screen.
The laptop uses a tandem OLED display, which Apple calls PROLED XDR. It promises deeper blacks, stronger contrast and improved colour accuracy. The display supports a refresh rate of up to 120Hz through ProMotion, with peak brightness reaching 2,000 nits for HDR content. Apple is also offering a nano-texture option to reduce reflections.
The new models are powered by the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, which are designed for demanding tasks such as video editing, 3D rendering, software development and AI workloads. Apple says the processors include Neural Accelerators in their GPU cores to speed up AI-related tasks. Storage configurations go up to 16TB, with the company claiming up to twice the storage speed.
Other upgrades include a redesigned thermal system, an improved six-speaker audio setup, a studio-quality three-microphone array and support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6. The laptop retains ports such as HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe 3 and a headphone jack, alongside three Thunderbolt 5 ports.
Apple claims the new MacBook Pro offers up to 24 hours of battery life and can charge to 50 per cent in 30 minutes. The redesigned models are also lighter than their predecessors. A major change in Apple's laptop strategy
A major change in Apple's laptop strategy
Apple's decision is notable because the company has resisted touchscreen Macs for years. In 2010, Steve Jobs described touchscreen laptops as “ergonomically terrible”. Two years later, former CEO Tim Cook argued against combining tablets and laptops, comparing the idea to converging a toaster and a refrigerator.
Apple later experimented with the Touch Bar, a touch-sensitive strip that replaced the function keys on MacBook Pro models introduced in 2016. However, the company brought back physical function keys in its 2021 redesign and discontinued the Touch Bar in 2023.
The new MacBook Pro represents a significant change in that approach, bringing direct touch interaction to Apple's flagship laptop while keeping its established keyboard-and-trackpad controls. - Ends

एप्पल ने बुधवार को अपने "प्रो एंड टेल" इवेंट में ओएलईडी डिस्प्ले और एम5 प्रो व एम5 मैक्स प्रोसेसर वाले अपने पहले टचस्क्रीन मैकबुक प्रो मॉडल की घोषणा की। यह लॉन्च लैपटॉप टच कंट्रोल पर कंपनी की लंबे समय से चली आ रही रणनीति में बदलाव को दर्शाता है।

### मैकबुक प्रो में क्या नया है

* **टचस्क्रीन सपोर्ट:** उपयोगकर्ता सीधे स्क्रीन पर स्क्रॉल, ज़ूम, ड्रा और एनोटेट कर सकते हैं, जिसका उद्देश्य 3डी मॉडलिंग और संगीत निर्माण जैसे पेशेवर वर्कफ़्लो में सहायता करना है।
* **PROLED XDR डिस्प्ले:** इसमें 120Hz तक के प्रोमोशन रिफ्रेश रेट, एचडीआर सामग्री के लिए 2,000 निट्स पीक ब्राइटनेस और वैकल्पिक नैनो-टेक्सचर फिनिश के साथ टैंडम ओएलईडी पैनल का उपयोग किया गया है।
* **प्रदर्शन:** एआई वर्कलोड के लिए न्यूरल एक्सीलरेटर से लैस एम5 प्रो और एम5 मैक्स चिप्स द्वारा संचालित, जिसमें स्टोरेज कॉन्फ़िगरेशन 16TB तक जाते हैं।
* **डिज़ाइन और सुविधाएँ:** पारंपरिक पोर्ट को बनाए रखते हुए हल्के बिल्ड, एक पुनर्निर्धारित थर्मल सिस्टम, वाई-फाई 7, ब्लूटूथ 6 और छह-स्पीकर ऑडियो सेटअप के साथ मैक में डायनेमिक आइलैंड पेश करता है।
* **बैटरी लाइफ:** एप्पल ने बताया कि लैपटॉप 24 घंटे तक की बैटरी लाइफ प्रदान करता है और 30 मिनट में 50 प्रतिशत तक फास्ट चार्जिंग का समर्थन करता है।

### भारत में कीमत और उपलब्धता

14 इंच के मैकबुक प्रो की कीमत 3,49,900 रुपये है, जबकि 16 इंच के वेरिएंट की कीमत 4,09,900 रुपये है। घोषणा के अनुसार, नए मॉडल 9 नवंबर से उपलब्ध होने वाले हैं।

### ऐतिहासिक संदर्भ

यह रिलीज़ एप्पल द्वारा डायरेक्ट टच लैपटॉप के प्रति वर्षों के विरोध को पलटती है। पूर्व नेतृत्व ने पहले क्षैतिज टचस्क्रीन और डिवाइस अभिसरण की आलोचना की थी। एप्पल ने पहले 2016 में टच बार पेश किया था, इससे पहले कि वह 2021 में भौतिक फंक्शन कीज़ पर वापस लौटा और 2023 में टच बार को बंद कर दिया।

### व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन

खरीदारों को खरीदारी से पहले सीधे एप्पल की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट या अधिकृत पुनर्विक्रेताओं के माध्यम से क्षेत्रीय वारंटी शर्तों, डिलीवरी समयसीमा और सटीक विनिर्देशों को सत्यापित करना चाहिए।

en_body:
Apple announced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro models featuring OLED displays and M5 Pro and M5 Max processors at its "Pro and tell" event on Wednesday. The launch marks a shift in the company's long-standing strategy regarding laptop touch controls.

### What is New in the MacBook Pro

* **Touchscreen Support:** Users can scroll, zoom, draw, and annotate directly on the screen, aiming to assist professional workflows like 3D modeling and music production.
* **PROLED XDR Display:** Utilizes a tandem OLED panel with up to 120Hz ProMotion refresh rates, 2,000 nits peak brightness for HDR content, and an optional nano-texture finish.
* **Performance:** Powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips featuring Neural Accelerators for AI workloads, with storage configurations scaling up to 16TB.
* **Design and Features:** Introduces Dynamic Island to the Mac alongside a lighter build, a redesigned thermal system, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and a six-speaker audio setup while retaining traditional ports.
* **Battery Life:** Apple stated the laptop offers up to 24 hours of battery life and supports fast charging up to 50 percent in 30 minutes.

### Pricing and Availability in India

The 14-inch MacBook Pro is priced at Rs 3,49,900, while the 16-inch variant costs Rs 4,09,900. According to the announcement, the new models are scheduled to become available starting November 9.

### Historical Context

This release reverses years of resistance to direct touch laptops by Apple. Former leadership previously criticized horizontal touchscreens and device convergence. Apple previously introduced the Touch Bar in 2016 before returning to physical function keys in 2021 and discontinuing the Touch Bar in 2023.

### Practical Implications and Verification

Buyers should verify regional warranty terms, delivery timelines, and exact specifications directly through Apple's official website or authorized resellers before purchase.
